lines.trans: Mom, why did you come here today?
What do you want with that strange teenager?
Max is a serious guy and a good cook.
Why do you always go to extremes?
This is my life, and I decide myself.
First married men, then kids, kids right away.
Stop criticizing me every single day!

words.gram: future, 3rd person singular, perfective; хватит! = enough!

lines.trans: Tell me, did you enroll the guy in school?

words.gloss: to write down; to save (a contact)

lines.trans: I do not want to discuss this now.
Otherwise I could have helped you.
Mom, please, just leave from here.
Alright, I will leave you in peace for now.

words.gram: prepositional singular, masculine; оставить в покое = leave alone

examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man.
I was born and grew up here.
Why are we going so slowly?
Nothing lasts forever under the moon.
I grew up in a communal flat.

You can see it at once.
